verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. CLAUDE-G08H-V1-B1 is landed. Frozen v1 enumerated root as a fourth peer install surface in previewInstallSurfaces and in the matrix while simultaneously describing root as the per-role accepted anchor — two cardinalities, with every EV passProperty silent on the disputed axis. v2 chooses the three-role machine axis v8 actually runs (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT), removes root from every operational enumeration, names the accepted-anchor and air-gap root-chain records that discharge the file-08 word Root inside each role, forbids the audit role field from being root or TR-ROOT, and states surface cardinality 3 on every EV passProperty beside the platform and connectivity cardinalities. The four-word scope phrase is still carried, and is now labelled scope prose rather than an evidence axis — which is what v1 said carrying it required. The rest of the attack surface that already held at v1 still holds: three live-cell members split on the correct punctuation, four connectivity classes and four executes limbs each carrying both fields, OD-112-1..4 named and not minted, CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED imported from v8 rather than invented, and the G06 / G07 / G15 / DR-112 / DR-110 / DR-113 / DR-103 splits each holding against the live rows. Existence still does not close leftover-design; this ACCEPT is of the candidate, not a recording and not QUALIFIED.
